rows.known_text: wanted to take them to the beach
rows.target_text: 浜まで連れて行きたかった

rows.known_text: the forest I wanted to take them to
rows.target_text: 連れて行きたかった森

rows.known_text: wanted to take them there on my own
rows.target_text: 一人で連れて行きたかった

rows.known_text: wanted to take them there without the car
rows.target_text: 車なしで連れて行きたかった

rows.known_text: I wanted to take them there while they were still young
rows.target_text: 若いうちに連れて行きたかった

rows.known_text: how far did you want to take them?
rows.target_text: どこまで連れて行きたかった

rows.known_text: both of them might have wanted to take them to the beach
rows.target_text: 二人とも浜まで連れて行きたかったかもしれない

rows.known_text: I heard they wanted to take them there many times
rows.target_text: 何度も連れて行きたかったって聞いた

rows.known_text: I made a promise because I wanted to take them there
rows.target_text: 連れて行きたかったから約束した

rows.known_text: I didn't think both of them wanted to take them there
rows.target_text: 二人とも連れて行きたかったとは思わなかった

rows.known_text: more than anything I wanted to take them there
rows.target_text: 何より連れて行きたかった

rows.known_text: if it had been my choice I'd have wanted to take them to the beach
rows.target_text: 自分の選択だったら浜まで連れて行きたかった

rows.known_text: in the old days I wanted to take them there so much
rows.target_text: 昔はあんなに連れて行きたかった
